performance_case.causal_mechanism: If next-day liquidity normalization after a complete UTC-day 3 percent shock is a direction-general historical mechanism rather than one-sided flow persistence, both UP and DOWN shock groups should independently retain negative signed-h24 medians and more reversals than continuations in both frozen Design and Validation windows.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This dispatch may inspect only the exact sealed historical result and its machine-validated semantic closure. It cannot read raw episodes or the H1 corpus, infer annual-by-direction breadth, alter the forward evaluator, define a factor or strategy, compute economics, register a hypothesis or candidate, open OOS, deploy, change canonical state or schedule, or perform any Trading action.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Immediate drawdown effect is zero. No strategy mapping, fee model, equity curve or path-risk ledger exists for this descriptive closure, so any later drawdown effect remains MISSING_PROOF until separately preregistered prospective and matched-capital evidence exists.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: A sealed direction-symmetry closure prevents unsupported one-sided strategy engineering and repeated raw-data work while the untouched forward evaluator matures. It costs no candidate budget and stops at MISSING_PROOF for annual directional breadth and economics.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: The audit itself cannot improve fee-adjusted total PnL. Its research value is deciding whether the accepted historical reversal prior is independently present after both UP and DOWN shocks across both frozen windows, thereby closing a one-sided interpretation before strategy work.
